title: actinn-jax-benchmark: harness, configurations and results for "Annotating single-cell data on a laptop"
description:
Benchmark harness, per-method adapters, run configurations, environment lockfiles, result tables and figure scripts for the preprint Annotating single-cell data on a laptop: a benchmark of annotation methods and practical low-memory workflows, with actinn-jax.

This archive is the code and the derived result tables. The pre-trained references it builds on are deposited separately at doi:10.5281/zenodo.21688150, and the six benchmark datasets are third-party and cited in the paper rather than redeposited here.
